sentences.text: **Scheme Brief Description:** The scheme aims to encourage higher education among girls in Bihar by providing a one-time incentive of ₹25,000/- to eligible graduate students of the state.
**Who is this for:** Individual; Category: Education & Learning; Sector: Scholarships and student finance

**Detailed Description:** The “Mukhyamantri Balika (Snatak) Protsahan Yojana”, is a component of the “Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojna”, launched by the Department of Education, Bihar. The scheme aims to promote higher education and empower girls by making them self-reliant. A lump sum incentive of ₹25,000/- is awarded to girl students from Bihar who have successfully graduated from recognized institutions within the state. The amount is directly transferred to the beneficiary&#39;s bank account.
**Benefits / Assistance:** - **Financial Incentive:** ₹25,000/- as a one-time allowance.

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Registration page](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/SnatakStudent/(S(g3mz4xgoeranmfbzt31lazfp))/Register.aspx). **Step 2:** Enter all the mandatory details and create a new password. Validate the Captcha code. **Step 3:** Click on “Submit” to generate the login ID and Password. > **Application Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the [Login page](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/SnatakStudent/(S(segtokfpkf2xy1vikgkqwhqx))/Login.aspx?Id=19). **Step 2:** Enter all the mandatory details and upload all the required documents. **Step 3:** Recheck all entries before final submission, no modifications can be made in the application after final submission. **Step 4:** Click on “Submit” and take a printout of a copy of the submitted application. > **Check application Details:** [Click Here.](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/SnatakStudent/(S(ibr5z42hxfxjsvsvthsdu5rm))/ApplicationStatusofStudent.aspx) > **Payment Done Information:** [Click Here.](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/SnatakStudent/(S(ibr5z42hxfxjsvsvthsdu5rm))/RPT/PaymentDoneInfo.aspx)  > ***Helpdesk:*** For technical problems: [Click Here](https://medhasoft.bih.nic.in/SnatakStudent/(S(hrbnlrdjhi3044o1rrfpc4n4))/HelpDesk.aspx). > ***Note:*** If the name of the concerned college is not in the list, the applicant should contact the Registrar of their University and request to add its name.
